posts.text: I don’t see dismissal here for vindictive prosecution (retaliation for exercising a legal right in the same or related case), but if ever there was a case for selective prosecution, this is it. DOJ has singled out Comey when it has not charged the many others who have engaged in similar conduct.
posts.summary: Criticizes selective prosecution of Comey as retaliatory overreach
